title: Trustworthy and Responsible AI for Human-Centric Autonomous Decision-Making Systems
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive transdisciplinary review of the literature and principles regarding Trustworthy and Responsible AI. While it centers on ethical principles such as beneficence, non-maleficence, autonomy, and justice, it does not conduct an empirical evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems.
